decisions: Low, confirmed, high confidence: with git's diff.noprefix set, the coverage gate scores a changed line that no test runs as 100 percent and passes (TC-8, against TC-7 which fails the same change). Who notices: a developer running the script on their own machine; CI's default git config is not affected.

Medium, unconfirmed, medium confidence: the CI coverage gate takes changed lines from base...head but coverage from the merge ref that checkout builds on a pull request, so it can score the wrong lines when main has changed the same file. Graded from .github/workflows/ci.yml line 49, not run: no GitHub Actions run is reachable here.
Low, confirmed by reading: the CI actions are pinned by tags, not commit SHAs, while the coverage-patch job holds statuses write.
Low, explained: the work folder's out/playwright.config.ts did not match the brief; I replaced it with the brief's text before any test.

TC-7 and TC-8 tagged R-14 and AC-1: the coverage gate runs Vitest with coverage, the unit harness of R-14. Both are annotated stub, as a fake git prints the diff, so neither counts toward AC-1's status.
No changed interface with callers: the repository is new, so callers is empty.
uncertain: Whether the CI coverage gate's merge-ref mismatch (medium) should be fixed in this Deliverable or a follow-up: the QA person decides.
Whether R-14 is the right Requirement for TC-7 and TC-8, the added coverage-gate checks; the QA person can retag them.
handoff.note: The QA app is a static build with no database, so no stored state was read. Playwright wrote test-results at the repository root, which .gitignore excludes. out/regression.json from the regression step was left as it was.

suggested_follow_ups: Pass --src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/ to the git diff call in scripts/coverage-patch.mjs, or parse paths without relying on the prefix.
Check out the pull request head sha in the CI test job, or diff against the merge ref, so the coverage gate's line numbers and lcov match.
Pin the GitHub Actions in .github/workflows/ci.yml to full commit SHAs.
